    , claim_identifier__company_claim_number

answer.sql:
WITH holder AS (
  SELECT apr.Agreement_Identifier AS Policy_Identifier,
         string_agg(DISTINCT CAST(pt.Party_Name AS VARCHAR), ', ') AS policyholder_name
  FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."agreement_party_role" apr
  JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."party_role" r ON r.Party_Role_Code = apr.Party_Role_Code
  JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."party" pt ON pt.Party_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
  WHERE lower(r.Party_Role_Name) LIKE '%policy%holder%'
  GROUP BY apr.Agreement_Identifier
),
prem AS (
  SELECT pa.Policy_Identifier,
         SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS total_premium
  FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."policy_amount" pa
  JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."premium" pr ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
  GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
),
policy_claims AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pcd.Policy_Identifier, cc.Claim_Identifier
  FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."claim_coverage" cc
  JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."policy_coverage_detail" pcd
    ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
   AND pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
),
loss AS (
  SELECT pc.Policy_Identifier,
         SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) + SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS total_incurred_loss
  FROM policy_claims pc
  JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."claim" c ON c.Claim_Identifier = pc.Claim_Identifier
  JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."claim_amount" ca ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
  GROUP BY pc.Policy_Identifier
)
SELECT p.Policy_Identifier,
       p.Policy_Number,
       h.policyholder_name,
       pr.total_premium,
       l.total_incurred_loss
FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."policy" p
LEFT JOIN holder h ON h.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN prem pr ON pr.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN loss l ON l.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
ORDER BY p.Policy_Number
LIMIT 500
